v1.note: legacy convention; the shipped gate verdicts were established here

v2.target: wOBA(Y+1) (within-OUTCOME-season z-score removes the era term)
v2.bootstrap: player-clustered (all of a player's pairs move together), season-stratified (players stratified by first predictor season); 2000 reps, seeded; CIs are wider by design
v2.note: transition-cycle companion; future gates must pre-declare v1 or v2

harness.pair_rule: Y->Y+1 pairs kept only when the OUTCOME season is complete (past Nov 15). Partial-year targets (e.g. mid-2026) are a defect, dropped under BOTH conventions.
harness.predictors: unrounded *_raw model scores (display rounding never enters evals)
interpretation_rules: existing VALIDATED ships STAND even if v2 weakens them; a reversal is flagged to the owner, not auto-reverted
ledgered NO-SHIPs are re-baselined under v2 but never revived by v2 alone
X-R2 / X-S2 flips are not promised

protocol.candidate: base + OLS(residual ~ z(avg_hit_speed) + z(brl_pa) + z(ev95percent)), coefs frozen on train
protocol.gate_rule: ev_corrected vs base: iid paired bootstrap lo95 >= 0 (v1)
protocol.ledger_position: EV as proj_ml TREE features was rejected 2026-06-23; this is the output-layer residual form, newly powered by the cache backfill
